body:
SHITHUB epic kickoff. New Route/add-route!/match-route/resource-routes on top of http/router.prn's own path matching, matching Rails' config/routes.rb (declarative routes + resources one-liner generating all 5 RESTful entries). Real, named restriction: handler-name is a plain String, not a callable function value (PARENA's fn is non-capturing/file-scope-only); match-route returns which route matched, app dispatch decides what to call. Two real compiler constraints worked around (struct literal needs a let before use as a call arg; pushing a struct value onto a Vec needs a real Arena to box into). New tests/test_http_routes.c, make test-http-routes green, -Werror -pedantic clean, full suite unaffected (342 passed). commit 52b2d92 (+fbc03d2 changelog).

⚓ ☃
title: stdlib/http/routes.prn -- Rails-like HTTP-method + route-table layer
